parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: DriverName
parameters.description: The driver name. Specify this parameter if you want to filter query results by driver name.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The driver type. Valid values:

- **0**: official driver.
- **1**: custom driver.
